description: Golden retrieval set for offline evaluation. Each case lists the chunk ids a strong retriever should surface for the query. Used to compute recall@k, MRR, and nDCG in CI so a knowledge-base or ranking change cannot silently regress retrieval.

cases.query: Design a high-converting SaaS landing page hero for a new analytics product
Pricing page that nudges users to the annual plan without dark patterns
Empty state for a dashboard with no data yet
Make the typography feel premium and readable on a marketing site
Accessible color system with proper contrast for light and dark mode
Add tasteful motion to a mobile onboarding flow
